description:
pkix-path/src/lib.rs line 2362:
  .flat_map(|nd| nd.expected_policy_set.iter().cloned())

ObjectIdentifier implements Copy (it is a fixed-size stack value). Using cloned() on an iterator over a Copy type forces through the Clone trait rather than Copy, which is semantically equivalent but signals incorrect understanding of the type. Use .copied() instead.

Clippy pedantic fires: 'used cloned where copied could be used instead'

Same pattern likely appears in other places where Vec<ObjectIdentifier> is iterated. A search for .cloned() in lib.rs would find any others.
title: cloned() should be copied() for ObjectIdentifier iterator in policy tree §6.1.5(g)
